name: com.hardikgoswami.oauthLibGithub.OauthActivity
description: Hardik Goswami's oauthLibGithub library opens this screen to sign the user into GitHub. It loads GitHub's authorization page, obtains and saves an access token, then returns to the configured app screen.
disableEffect: GitHub sign-in cannot complete, so app features that require that account or token may stop working.
